breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflicting instructions regarding the numerical method. The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified both 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'Strang splitting'. The ground truth corrects this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction entirely, as Strang splitting is the intended method. The agent, however, combined the conflicting terms, stating to 'use an explicit forward Euler method with Strang splitting', which is a confusing and incorrect description of the algorithm and fails to fix the original contradiction.
